title: Galaga 3.8 — High-Fidelity Arcade
why: Create a brand-new, self-contained Galaga clone with high-fidelity synthesized audio, rich canvas graphics, and faithful arcade gameplay.
outcomes: Single HTML file playable in any browser; Web Audio API synthesized SFX and music; procedural sprite rendering with animation; multi-wave enemy formations, boss battles, power-ups, score/lives system

milestones.name: Audio Engine
milestones.objective: Procedural sound effects and background music via Web Audio API oscillators, filters, and envelopes
milestones.success: All SFX (shoot, explode, enemy dive, power-up, wave start, game over) and looping BGM audible with no external assets
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
    A[Game Event] --> B{SFX or Music}
    B -->|SFX| C[Oscillator + Envelope]
    B -->|Music| D[Pattern Sequencer]
    C --> E[Filter Chain]
    D --> E
    E --> F[Master Gain]
    F --> G[Speaker]

tasks.name: SFX Synthesizer
tasks.what: Implement Web Audio API SFX engine with oscillator-based sound effects for all game events (shoot, explosion, enemy dive, power-up, wave intro, game over).
tasks.why: Provides high-fidelity procedural audio without external files.
snippet:
class SfxEngine {
  constructor(ctx) // AudioContext
  shoot()        // short square-wave blip w/ pitch drop
  explode(size)  // noise burst + low sine thump
  enemyDive()    // descending sawtooth sweep
  powerUp()      // ascending arpeggio
  waveIntro()    // dramatic chord hit
  gameOver()     // long descending tone
}
acceptance: Each SFX method produces distinct audible sound via Web Audio API
No external audio files required
verify: open in browser, trigger each event, confirm audio plays

tasks.name: Music Sequencer
tasks.what: Implement looping background music sequencer with tempo-based pattern playback, intensity scaling per wave, and mute toggle.
tasks.why: Immersive arcade atmosphere that escalates with difficulty.
acceptance: Music loops seamlessly without gaps
Tempo/intensity increases with wave number
Mute/unmute via M key
verify: play game through 2+ waves, confirm music evolves

milestones.name: Graphics & Sprites
milestones.objective: High-fidelity sprite rendering, particle effects, and visual polish using Canvas 2D with procedural pixel-art sprites
milestones.success: All entities rendered as animated multi-frame sprites; explosions use particle systems; background has parallax starfield; no external image assets
milestones.diagram:
graph TD
    A[Game Loop] --> B[Render Pipeline]
    B --> C[Starfield Layer]
    B --> D[Entity Sprites]
    B --> E[Particle System]
    B --> F[UI / HUD]
    D --> G[Sprite Atlas - procedural]
    G --> H[Frame Animation]

tasks.name: Sprite System & Starfield
tasks.what: Implement procedural pixel-art sprite atlas (player, 3 enemy types, boss, power-ups) with multi-frame animation, plus parallax starfield background.
tasks.why: All visual identity without external assets; animated sprites give arcade feel.
acceptance: Player and all 3 enemy types render as distinct animated sprites
Boss renders at 2x scale with unique design
3-layer parallax starfield scrolls continuously
verify: open in browser, confirm all sprites visible and animating

tasks.name: Particle & VFX System
tasks.what: Implement particle-based explosion effects, screen shake, muzzle flash, and entity death animations.
tasks.why: Juice and feedback that makes hits feel impactful.
acceptance: Explosions produce 20+ colored particles with gravity and fade
Screen shakes on player hit (intensity ~8px, decay 300ms)
Muzzle flash visible for 1 frame on shoot
verify: shoot enemies, confirm particle burst + shake on player hit

milestones.name: Core Gameplay
milestones.objective: Player ship, enemy AI with dive patterns, collision detection, scoring, lives, and game state machine
milestones.success: Full playable loop: start → waves → boss → power-ups → game over → restart; all collisions correct; score/lives tracked
milestones.diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Title
    Title --> WaveIntro : Enter
    WaveIntro --> Playing : animation done
    Playing --> BossFight : wave 4+
    BossFight --> Playing : boss defeated
    Playing --> GameOver : lives = 0
    GameOver --> Title : Enter
    Playing --> Paused : P
    Paused --> Playing : P

tasks.name: Player Ship & Input
tasks.what: Implement player ship with keyboard/touch controls (left/right/up/down), shooting with cooldown, invincibility frames after hit, and 3 lives.
tasks.why: Core player interaction; must feel responsive at 60fps.
snippet:
class Player {
  x, y, w, h
  speed: 280        // px/s horizontal
  shootCooldown: 0.15
  invincible: 0     // seconds remaining
  lives: 3

  update(dt, input)
  shoot() // returns bullet entity
  hit()   // decrement lives, set invincible=2s
}
acceptance: Arrow keys / WASD move ship smoothly at 60fps
Space fires bullets with 150ms cooldown
After being hit, ship blinks for 2s (invincible)
Lives display in HUD; game over at 0
verify: play 30s, confirm movement is smooth, shooting works, hit reduces life

tasks.name: Enemy AI & Formations
tasks.what: Implement 3 enemy types (bee, butterfly, fighter) with formation entry animation, idle bobbing, and dive attacks; boss appears every 4 waves.
tasks.why: Faithful Galaga enemy behavior: coordinated dives, different point values, escalating difficulty.
acceptance: Enemies enter formation via animated spiral path
Bee=100pts, Butterfly=200pts, Fighter=400pts
Dive frequency increases with wave number
Boss spawns on waves 4, 8, 12... with unique sprite
verify: play through wave 4, confirm boss appears and can be defeated

tasks.name: Collision, Scoring & Power-ups
tasks.what: Implement AABB collision detection (bullets vs enemies, enemies vs player, enemy bullets vs player), score tracking with high-score persistence, and 4 power-up types.
tasks.why: Game loop completion: hits register, score accumulates, power-ups add depth.
acceptance: Bullet-enemy collision destroys enemy, awards points
Enemy-player collision costs a life
Combo multiplier resets after 2s without kill
High score persists across page reloads via localStorage
All 4 power-ups spawn and have correct effects
verify: play 2 min, confirm scoring, combo, power-up pickup, high-score save

milestones.success: Complete game shell: title → play → pause → game over flow; HUD shows score/lives/wave/power-up timer; canvas scales to viewport; 60fps stable

tasks.name: Game Shell & HUD
tasks.what: Implement title screen, pause overlay, game-over screen with stats, HUD (score, high-score, lives icons, wave number, active power-up timer), and responsive canvas scaling.
tasks.why: Complete game presentation; player needs clear state feedback.
acceptance: Title screen shows game name, high score, and start prompt
Pause freezes all entities and music
Game over shows final score and restarts on Enter
Canvas maintains aspect ratio at any window size
